facts.fact: Guided visits address the Capilla Mayor murals, artist biography and interpretations of the frescos.
Visitors can request a guided visit at visitor services immediately right of the museum entrance.
Spanish and English guided visit times are published, but may change without notice.
The museum address is Calle Cabañas8 at Plaza Tapatía, Guadalajara.
The operator currently publishes Tuesday–Sunday10:00–17:00 and freeTuesday admission.
